h:
简单的工作流程字符传输风格

  • 上传角色图片或提示生成新的角色图片。

  • 将参考图像上传到您想要组合风格的位置。

  • 零提示，因为佛罗伦萨会为您做这件事。

实际上，我创建这个工作流程是为了为我自己的 LoRA 训练准备数据集。我遇到的一个常见问题是没有足够多样化的数据集来训练 LoRA。但有了这个工作流程，一切都变得更加容易。 PULID Flux 和 Redux Flux 给我留下了深刻的印象，它们都让我的工作变得更轻松。

由于它们效果很好，我想与大家分享。 ૮ ˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ ა

o.en:
Simple Workflow Character Tranfer Style

  • Upload Character Image or Prompt for Generate new one.

  • Upload Referance Image where you want to combine style.

  • Zero prompt because Florence will do that for you.

Actually this workflow I created to prepare a dataset for LoRA training of myself. A common problem I run into is not having a diverse enough dataset to train LoRA. But with this workflow everything becomes much easier. PULID Flux and Redux Flux have impressed me greatly, they both make my job easier.

And since they work so well, I felt like sharing them with everyone. ૮ ˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶ ა
